name: SHADOVIS RPG
desc:
RPG game where you collect loot, buy gear, explore the world traversing through 7 different realms to become the ULTIMATE warrior. Weapons are very unique in this game and have special moves based on their type.

Collect Cubits across the map to gain permanent XP power-ups. There are over 200 to find.

Support the game for more updates. Releasing a new code at 125K likes.

Have fun playing!

UPDATE:
* Added the final boss.
* Use code '100klikes' for a strong item! Can be fused into something even more powerful...

Left-Click to Attack
Q to Roll
Shift to Sprint 
E / R / F for Skill keys

scripts.title: Collect All Cubits
scripts.features: Gets all cubits around the workspace, I don't believe it can get cubits from drops.
scripts.script:
-- Gives you 101 Cubits / +1010% Xp Gain

local Cubits = game.Workspace["Client Cubits"]:GetChildren()

for _,v in ipairs(Cubits) do
	if v:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") then
		local Prox = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
		fireproximityprompt(Prox)
	end
end

scripts.title: kill aura
scripts.features: i discovered it, not a big deal its only copy the remote of hitting a monster and putting it into a loop
scripts.script:
-- change the Goblin Lv 1 at the bottom for the mob u want
-- change the Basic sword to your sword name

_G.killaura = true -- true for enabled and false for disabled

while _G.killaura == true do
local args = {
    [1] = "Input",
    [2] = "Basic Sword", -- here
    [3] = 0.5262976843135896,
    [4] = "SlashEvent",
    [5] = workspace.NPCs:FindFirstChild("Goblin Lv 1").HumanoidRootPart
} ---------------------------------- on there

game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.Combat.RemoteEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
task.wait()
end
